title: Xchonnect dApp origin document (/.well-known/xchonnect.json)
description: Fetch rules: HTTPS GET https://<d>/.well-known/xchonnect.json; no redirects; Content-Type application/json; body at most 16 KiB; timeout 10 s; no cookies or credentials sent. Wallets MAY cache for at most 24 h but MUST re-fetch when pairing. A key is valid through 23:59:59 UTC on its not_after date.

pk.description: base64url (no padding) Ed25519 public key, 32 bytes

return_url.description: Same-device flow return URL (spec 8.2). Its authority MUST be byte-identical to the pairing URI's `d`: not a subdomain, no port, no userinfo, no trailing dot, and written in the same lowercase A-label form. Wallets MUST reject the whole document otherwise; `icon` carries no such rule.
